summary: Iteration 17 re-test of the host-allowlist approach for GoogleAuthErrorHelp banner. All acceptance criteria pass end-to-end: banner renders proactively on /login and /register on the preview host (not in KNOWN_GOOD_GOOGLE_HOSTS), origin element shows the current window.location.origin, console link points to https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials with target=_blank, copy button writes origin to clipboard, dismiss button hides the banner and persists per-origin under localStorage 'gsi-help-dismissed:<origin>', dismissal survives full page reload, clearing that key restores the banner, and setting the flag for a different origin (https://apkamunim.com) does NOT hide the current-origin banner (per-origin isolation confirmed). Backend regression: POST /api/auth/google -> 401 on invalid credential, POST /api/auth/register and /api/auth/login both return 200. /app/GOOGLE_OAUTH_FIX.md exists (3537 bytes, >2KB). /app/memory/test_credentials.md unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: GoogleAuthErrorHelp uses window.location.origin as the storage-key suffix; matches the intended per-origin isolation contract.
isKnownGoodGoogleOrigin() checks hostname (not full origin) so http vs https on same host would still be considered whitelisted — acceptable but worth noting if staging on http is ever added.
Kept-but-unused file /app/frontend/src/hooks/useGsiOriginErrorDetector.js is dead code; consider deleting or documenting its future-use intent to avoid confusion.
test_credentials: Fresh TEST_iter17_* users registered per run via POST /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: One TEST_iter17_<uuid>@example.com user per pytest run — no cleanup endpoint invoked (safe, TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banner logic is now host-allowlist based; no console.error sniffing. KNOWN_GOOD_GOOGLE_HOSTS in /app/frontend/src/lib/googleOrigins.js currently contains only apkamunim.com and www.apkamunim.com. Any other host (preview, localhost:*, staging) will show the amber banner immediately on /login and /register. localStorage key format: 'gsi-help-dismissed:<origin>'. Full Google sign-in flow remains out of scope (origin not whitelisted in Google Console — user action).
notes: The 'Origin copied' Sonner toast could not be visually captured by Playwright locator (likely dismissed before wait_for resolved), but navigator.clipboard.readText() returned the correct origin value, confirming the copy handler works. Not a bug.
